_readme: Business-confirmed override: ALL YUPI-branded items use GR (gram) as their canonical Global Base Unit. Scanned across the full 1,165-SKU Global Master v5 for item_name containing 'YUPI' (case-insensitive) -- exactly 2 matches, both listed below. Wherever the legacy/master data recorded PCS for these SKUs, that is treated as an old MISLABEL of the same GR-based item, not as a real PCS-to-GR packaging conversion -- no conversion factor is invented. Applies ONLY to these 2 SKUs; no other SKU (YUPI or otherwise) is affected.
